summary: Module 03 CONTEXT: design docs catch cross-team constraints before build; min useful doc is 1-page RFC with problem, proposed approach, alternatives, and ask for review.
evidence: Q1: Wrong approach mid-build caught earlier by circulating a short design/RFC to infra/owners (WebSockets/$200K load-balancer story).
Q2: Minimum feedback doc: problem statement, proposed approach, 1–2 alternatives rejected, dependencies/constraints ask, success metric — one page.
Design doc = should we / how (before decision); spec = exactly what (after decision).
